WITH telescope_avgs AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT t.avg_pulse_rate
  FROM telescope_avgs AS t
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > o.overall_avg
), second_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_of_kept
  FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
  SELECT f.avg_pulse_rate
  FROM first_kept AS f
  CROSS JOIN second_avg AS s
  WHERE f.avg_pulse_rate > s.avg_of_kept
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_average_pulse_rate,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - s.avg_of_kept) AS avg_above_second_average
FROM final_kept
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
CROSS JOIN second_avg AS s;
